1. (Currently amended) A combination product comprising: (A) BH4 [[, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor]] __or a biosynthetic precursor thereof__; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII), wherein the inhibitor is a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist,__ [[or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof,]] wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

2. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4 [[, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor]], __or a biosynthetic precursor thereof,__ an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII), wherein the inhibitor is a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist,__ [[or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof,]] and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

3. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4 [[, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor]], __or a biosynthetic precursor thereof,__ in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII), wherein the inhibitor is a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist,__ [[or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof,]] in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

4. (Previously presented) A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 3, wherein components (I) and (II) are suitable for sequential, separate and/or simultaneous use in the treatment of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by microvascular dysfunction and/or lesions.

5. (Previously presented) A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 4, wherein the condition is hypertension, diabetic retinopathy, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and/or glomerulosclerosis.
